messages:
anya: Heads-up: PR needs to land before next branch cut. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4410
liz: which cut are we talking about?
anya: v2.2 cut is 2026-05-05 21:00 UTC. I want the PR merged by 18:30 UTC to allow preview + editorial pass.
mike: can we do 18:30 merge? I can handle merge commit and watch for release conflicts.
sam: I'll run the smoke tests at 17:45 UTC (nav check, run SDK snippet).
docs-ci-bot: Preview built: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4410  link-check: failed (1 broken anchor), lint: warn (code block line length).
anya: broken anchor is my mistake in migration guide section. pushing fix now.
editor-jen: also note a small language tweak in the migration intro  I'll add an inline suggestion in the preview.
liz: SDK snippet needs the new constructor shape  update example to the async client and include brief compat note for legacy.
anya: adding both fixes in two commits (anchor fix + snippet/update). please don't squash so we can revert snippet alone if needed.
mike: merging with merge-commit at 18:30 UTC unless CI fails again.
sam: +1. I'll post smoke pass at 18:10.
docs-ci-bot: New preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4410  link-check: pass, lint: warn.
editor-jen: reviewed and suggested one small phrasing change; not blocking.
release-bot: Reminder: release branch cut scheduled 2026-05-05 21:00 UTC. Anything merged after that will require backport.
anya: thanks everyone. Merging plan stands for 18:30. I'll update if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
